summary.narrative: The pooled counter-authority gate (240 rows per question, 90 counter rows) has been accepted for several cycles; nothing in this cycle touches it. What had never been measured is whether the known contrary authorities survive when the counter channel is read per LANGUAGE - the shape a single-language adversarial pass would actually produce. They do not: the per-language hit sets are proper subsets of the accepted pooled hits on every question (control C2, 4/4), Italian reaches zero of nine on rent-default and zero of six on corporate-criminal-liability, French reaches zero on both corporate questions, and only petty-theft-dismissal holds in all three languages. A single-language counter pass therefore loses known contrary authority. Independently, the lane's state file had been a 10/11-key truncation since the 39548140787 snapshot; the restoration that cycle's own resume instrument promised was never landed and three accepted cycles shipped the truncation. Both DO-NOT-SERVE orders stand, admission stays fail-closed, and owner_decision_required stays false.
